title: chore(deps): fold Dependabot PRs #234-#237 into moe/work-2026-10-24: ws 8.22.0 -> 8.22.1 and @types/node 26.6.5 -> 26.6.6 in packages/moe-daemon and packages/moe-proxy (package.json and package-lock.json only), so the bumps land with PR #230 instead of conflicting with it on main
description:
Filed by the governor (governor-e6142a94) on 2026-11-04 at the human's request: "fold the dependabot bumps into the work branch".

WHY
- Dependabot opened 4 PRs against main on 11-04 at 00:23Z:
  - #237: ws 8.22.0 -> 8.22.1 in /packages/moe-daemon
  - #236: ws 8.22.0 -> 8.22.1 in /packages/moe-proxy
  - #235: @types/node 26.6.5 -> 26.6.6 in /packages/moe-daemon
  - #234: @types/node 26.6.5 -> 26.6.6 in /packages/moe-proxy
- main moves only by PR (the human's decision of 11-02). PR #230 carries this branch, 581 commits ahead of main.
- Merging the Dependabot PRs into main would make PR #230 conflict on the same package.json and lockfile lines. Folding the same bumps in here means they land with PR #230, and Dependabot then closes #234-#237 itself, because the dependency is already up to date.

EXACT CHANGE. Each PR touches only its package's package.json (+1/-1) and package-lock.json (+4/-4). Read them with `gh.exe pr diff <n>` (WSL has only gh.exe).
- package.json: dependencies.ws "^8.22.0" -> "^8.22.1"; devDependencies["@types/node"] "^26.6.5" -> "^26.6.6".
- package-lock.json:
  - The root packages[""] spec lines change the same way.
  - packages["node_modules/ws"] and packages["node_modules/@types/node"] change version, resolved and integrity to exactly the values in the PR diffs. For ws 8.22.1 that is integrity sha512-oyL6OPYme/CmiFvNuGzeoxCJ4nOrZE2O1FwM9MWM1AsGri6nLXB2pg+lNA8aLeXMSav0J6eIVS1j6vUPzUtK9g==, per #237.
- The PR diffs are against main, so apply their hunks to this branch's files, which may sit at other line numbers. Use `git apply --3way` on the gh.exe diff, or edit by hand, or run `npm install <pkg>@<ver> --package-lock-only` in each package directory.
- Whichever method you use, the result must be exactly these lines. Revert any other lockfile churn, such as an npm version re-resolving other packages or changing lockfileVersion.
- Work only in the task worktree. Never install or build in the shared checkout: its packages/moe-daemon/dist is the live runtime.

OUT OF SCOPE
- moe-vscode and packages/moe-claude-plugin also declare ws ^8.22.0 and @types/node ^26.6.5. .github/dependabot.yml does not cover them (it covers daemon, proxy, gradle and github-actions), so the human's "fold the dependabot bumps" does not include them. Leave them unchanged.
- No GitHub action on PRs #234-#237: no close, comment or merge. They close themselves when PR #230 merges.
- No daemon swap. The live daemon picks up ws 8.22.1 at the next governor restage.

RISK. ws 8.22.1's release notes:
- IPC URL paths are no longer truncated at ':';
- node's http.websocketMask/Unmask are used when available, instead of bufferutil;
- Sender.frame() no longer returns empty chunks.
The daemon (/ws, /mcp, /runner) and the proxy (ws client) both use ws, so run both packages' tests.

implementationPlan.description:
Apply Dependabot PRs #236 (ws 8.22.0 -> 8.22.1) and #234 (@types/node 26.6.5 -> 26.6.6) to packages/moe-proxy with the main session's own Edit tool. The rails and the error handling are the same as in step 1; compare with `gh.exe pr diff 236` / `gh.exe pr diff 234` if an anchor misses.
The old and new strings are IDENTICAL to step 1's: the proxy lock's ws and @types/node entries are byte-identical to the daemon's. Only the line numbers differ:
- package.json: line 65 (ws) and line 68 (@types/node);
- package-lock.json: root spec lines 12 and 18, the @types/node block at 831-833, and the ws block at 2068-2070.
Do not touch moe-vscode/package*.json or packages/moe-claude-plugin/package*.json. They pin the same old versions, but .github/dependabot.yml does not cover them, so they are out of scope.

Verification. Run it ONCE, from the task worktree root: the executionContract checkRef, verbatim. Save the text to a scratch file outside the checkout, then run `bash <file> > <scratch>/gate.log 2>&1; echo EXIT=$?` with the Bash timeout at 600000 ms. The daemon suite prints about 107k lines; the planning dry run took 2 min.
What the command checks:
(1) DoD 1. `git diff --stat` against the merge-base with moe/work-2026-10-24 must list only the 4 files. The sha256 of `git diff --numstat` plus the sorted -U0 changed lines must equal fdb4dad0cc6c0f593638140413605532f9e56214bbaa5e5d5a85d411bddb6997. That value was derived from the four PR diffs: `(printf '8\t8\tpackages/moe-daemon/package-lock.json\n2\t2\tpackages/moe-daemon/package.json\n8\t8\tpackages/moe-proxy/package-lock.json\n2\t2\tpackages/moe-proxy/package.json\n'; for n in 234 235 236 237; do gh.exe pr diff $n; done | tr -d '\r' | grep -E '^[-+] ' | LC_ALL=C sort) | sha256sum`. So any extra line, file or churn fails the check.
(2) DoD 2. This step follows the global rail: npm runs only in a snapshot outside the repo, and the worktree has no node_modules anyway. The command copies the WHOLE tree to `mktemp -d` with `git archive HEAD`, because daemon tests read the root .gitignore, docs/, CLAUDE.md and scripts/. It then copies the 4 files over from the worktree. Under env -i (no MOE_* variables, no Windows PATH, the nvm node first), it runs npm ci and npm run build in the daemon, then in the proxy. Both dists therefore exist before the daemon tests, so baselineRun's real-daemon rows run. Finally it runs npm test and `npm ls ws @types/node` in each package; the npm ls versions must be exactly ws@8.22.1 and @types/node@26.6.6.
(3) It prints both vitest summaries and `GATE-OK <snapshot>`.
Expected: the planning dry run (2026-11-04, these exact edits on 9e9e7345, from a scratch clone) was green. The daemon had 293 files, 7630 passed | 18 skipped; the proxy had 9 files, 335 passed. The snapshot build regenerates src/generated/initFiles.ts; that is expected and stays in the snapshot (mem:gotcha-npm12-pack-json-node24-test-reporter-tar-snapshot-build). The npm warning that allowScripts blocked esbuild's postinstall is harmless.
Error handling for a red run:
- Hash mismatch: run `diff <(git diff -U0 $B | grep -E '^[-+] ' | LC_ALL=C sort) <(for n in 234 235 236 237; do gh.exe pr diff $n; done | tr -d '\r' | grep -E '^[-+] ' | LC_ALL=C sort)` and `git diff --numstat $B`, fix the bytes with Edit, and re-run.
- npm ci EINTEGRITY, or 'not in sync': a typo in steps 1-2.
- A failing test: re-run that file alone in the snapshot package with `npx vitest run <file>`. Three are known load flakes: index.version.test.ts, bindHosts.test.ts D-fail and baselineRun.test.ts E2 (mem:gotcha-daemon-linux-snapshot-gate). Check `uptime`, then re-run the whole command once.
- A failure that reproduces: repeat the snapshot without the overlay. If it fails there too, it is pre-existing at the tip; if not, ws 8.22.1 caused it. Either way, moe.report_blocked with both logs. Do not edit sources or tests, and do not fall back to 8.22.0.
- A network or registry error: re-run once, then report_blocked.
Submit the command text verbatim as complete_task verification.command, with exit 0 and the log tail (the npm ls trees, the 4 summary lines, GATE-OK). Leave the snapshot in place for QA.

4. npm ci, build and test in place in the worktree. Rejected: the global rail requires a snapshot outside the repo.
